On a fresh clone without `origin/HEAD`, `shipmill decide classify --files docs/product.md` exits 2 because the checkout lacks the ref. Make it read the levels from the working tree's `.github/shipmill.toml` instead and exit 0, so scripts that call it stop failing on such clones.
